threads.body: Regenerate and commit `scenarios/gen-ai/python/pydantic-ai/native/data.json` with Pydantic AI 2.46.0. Version 2.45.0 began reporting each agent run's token usage on its agent span, but the committed report still lists `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` and `gen_ai.usage.output_tokens` as missing from `gen_ai.invoke_agent.internal`. The report is therefore stale, and the GenAI scenario check will detect the difference.

Regenerate and commit `scenarios/gen-ai/python/google-adk/native/data.json` for this upgrade. Google ADK 2.9.2 changes how OpenTelemetry event names are preserved outside Agent Engine; this native scenario runs outside Agent Engine with event capture enabled, so its committed event coverage must be produced again with the upgraded runtime. Otherwise CI's scenario-tree comparison can detect a stale report.
